title: If you thought this video was a roller coaster, try watching this pla...
transcript: let's go ahead and pair this piece of musical theater news with a piece of musical theater history and I'll finish off with a hilarious picture of me from my high school play which I promise will be tangentially relevant so it was just announced that there's gonna be a new musical adaptation of Thornton Wilder's Pulitzer winning play The Skin of Our Teeth which is fun, but did you know that one of the most iconic musical theater duos of all time already adapted this play into a musical? the original play premiered in 1942 and it's an absolutely wackadoodle look at the history of mankind blending time periods breaking the fourth wall and lots of other insanity many of you might have seen it pretty recently there was a fairly brilliant Broadway revival just a couple years ago that had by the way the 2nd-coolest puppet I've ever seen on stage guess what number one is in the comments I dare you The new musical adaptation is called The Seat of Our Pants it'll play at the Public next fall and it's written by Ethan Lipton funny enough he has another musical that's about to premiere in just a couple months called We Are Your Robots at TFANA although I mostly know him from writing one of the funniest plays I've ever seen, Tumacho but back to my main point which is that none other than Kander & Ebb the legendary songwriting duo behind Cabaret, Chicago, many more actually wrote a musical adaptation of this play which premiered in 1999 at Virginia's Signature Theater the musical was originally called “Over and Over” although it was later renamed to “All About Us” when it had another run at Westport Country Playhouse in 2007 regrettably it never did play New York and I have to say as much as I'm looking forward to Ethan Lipton's adaptation and as much as I loved the Broadway revival I feel like the universe is teasing me a little bit cause I have been itching to see a return of the Kander and Ebb musical for many, many years the score only exists now in demos and bootlegs which of course I would never listen to because it's illegal but I have friends (or rather EX-friends) who have listened to it and told me that the score is really good and very much a hidden gem in the Kander & Ebb canon on that note the legendary Eartha Kitt actually had kind of a featured, cameo role in the 2007 production and she got to sing “Rain” which my ex-friends tell me is definitely the best song in the show and they also tell me that you can find a recording of it right now on YouTube although I wouldn't know because again it's illegal you've all been very patient so as promised here is a picture of me playing the lead in The Skin of Our Teeth in my sophomore year of high school you might say that I was severely miscast because there weren't enough boys but I would say that nothing says “commanding, hyper-masculine patriarch” like those adorable cheeks
classificationReason: Creator discusses a newly announced musical adaptation ('The Seat of Our Pants' at the Public) of Thornton Wilder's 'The Skin of Our Teeth.' This is news/announcement commentary with no first-hand review of a production. The announced show is not on the provided list.
